prerequisites.en: Mathematics - calculus and differential equations, because every reactor equation is an integral of a rate law; physical chemistry - kinetics, equilibrium and thermodynamics; and material & energy balance with the elements of fluid flow, because a reactor is a vessel with a flow through it.
prerequisites.gu: ગણિત - calculus અને differential equations, કારણ કે દરેક reactor equation એ rate law નું integral છે; physical chemistry - kinetics, equilibrium અને thermodynamics; અને material & energy balance તથા fluid flow ના પાયા, કારણ કે reactor એ flow ધરાવતું vessel છે.

rationale.en: A reactor is where the money of a chemical plant is made, and its design pulls together thermodynamics, kinetics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, mass transfer and economics. This subject gives the diploma engineer the tools to select a reactor, size it, and fix its operating conditions from laboratory kinetic data.
rationale.gu: Chemical plant ની આવક reactor માંથી જ થાય છે, અને તેની design માં thermodynamics, kinetics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, mass transfer તથા economics એકસાથે આવે છે. આ subject diploma engineer ને laboratory kinetic data પરથી reactor પસંદ કરવા, તેનું size નક્કી કરવા અને operating conditions ઠરાવવાના tools આપે છે.

suggested_projects.en: Collect the kinetic data of the saponification experiment of your laboratory, fit zero, first and second order equations to it and report which order the data supports, with the residues of each fit.
